newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research raised.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said analyst Erika Klauer raised the rating on Lam Research Corp and Applied Materials Inc to strong buy from hold.

-- cited several reasons for the Lam upgrade, including low stock price; recent appointment of Jim Bagley, "one of the most respected individuals in the semiconductor equipment industry," as chief executive; "excellent relationships with kep customers"; and recent acquisition of OnTrak Systems Inc.
-- said risks include: order recovery expected to be bumpy; strength of dollar could create problems in Japan; and "robust" competition.

-- For Applied Materials, cited near-term orders accelerating; is market leader in markets it serves as maker of semiconductor equipment; "extremely strong balance sheet; and recent retreat of the stock.
-- risks include "bumpy" road for order recovery; strength of dollar; and robust competition.
-- Lam rose 3/8 to 28-12/4, while Applied Materials jumped 1-5/16 to 51-1/8.
